chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, wants to resurrect the creation, He makes the sky rain upon the earth for forty days, then the limbs come together and flesh grows.
ai.seo_question: How does the body get resurrected according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd* elucidates the physical mechanism of bodily resurrection (*ba'th al-jasad*), emphasizing the divine power to reconstitute decayed bodies through a forty-day period of rain. In Shia scholarly tradition, this process is often linked to the concept of *Naskh al-Awal* (the first creation) serving as a prototype for the second creation, reinforcing the tangible nature of the afterlife. The imagery of rain reassembling bones and regenerating flesh underscores the ease with which Allah can reverse the natural order of decay.
